t: In front of you is a marble statue of George II, standing in the centre of an open square within the Old Royal Naval College in Greenwich. It has been Grade II listed since June 1973. It depicts the king who reigned over Great Britain and Ireland from 1727 until his death in 1760. The sculptor was John Michael Rysbrack, a Flemish artist who spent most of his career in England and was one of the foremost makers of monuments and portraits there in the first half of the eighteenth century.
